text: The profile success test checks one Glean.mail.import event and the exact importer/types/result metadata. Its current path is mailnews/import/test/browser/browser_importProfile.js, while the historical landing used mail/test/browser/import/browser_importProfile.js. Calendar and address-book tests likewise compare event extras. Preserve the explicit metadata assertions when changing these local schema values. These tests were inspected, not run; one success event does not establish all failure or unzip paths. Complete Bugzilla and historical Phabricator timeline/inline discussion remains pending.
title: Check import telemetry metadata as well as event count
